desc:
🎭 The show starts SOON and NOBODY is in their seat!
🎟️ You're an usher working at the theatre. Grab the guests, read their ticket, and get them into the right row and seat before the show starts!

🪑 Match the ROW LETTER and the SEAT NUMBER
🔓 Fill a section to unlock the next: Stalls ➡️ Mezzanine ➡️ Balcony ➡️ Upper Circle ➡️ VIP BOXES
🔥 Chain correct seats for a COMBO multiplier
⚡ Upgrades & 4 abilities to seat faster
🏆 Hit 100% for a FULL HOUSE and the SHOWTIME finale
♾️ ENCORE to reset with a PERMANENT ticket multiplier
👥 Solo or co-op — 2, 3, 4 and 6 player theatres!
🥇 Race the global leaderboards for the fastest Full House
👠🎸 Seat 100 guests to unlock the new FASHION RUNWAY MAP and 250 to unlock the new CONCERT ARENA MAP! 🎶🎤🎸

👍 LIKE for more updates & new maps! 👍

🎮 CONTROLS

💻 PC — E/Click: pick up & seat · Q: drop · 1/2/3/4: abilities
📱 Mobile — tap a guest, tap a seat · on-screen ability buttons
